results.name: Starbucks Disposable Cup
results.description:
Realistic 3D model of a Starbucks-style disposable coffee cup, perfect for use in branding mockups, product visualizations, café scenes, and realistic environment renders.

This model features:

✅ Detailed paper cup with accurate proportions

✅ Removable plastic lid with slot detail

✅ Cardboard sleeve with realistic texture

✅ PBR materials for paper, plastic, and cardboard

✅ Optimized geometry with clean topology

✅ Ready for rendering or real-time applications

Included in the model:

GLB FORMAT
